invariants.description: FIBA-WABC Mini-Basketball coaches manual 5.2: the shot clock should not be introduced until the U14 age group.
FIBA-WABC Mini-Basketball coaches manual 5.2 references quarters for substitutions and scoring modifications.

Mini-Basketball manual does not mandate a single fixed quarter length; period_duration_ms uses FIBA Official Basketball Rules Art. 8.1 (10 minutes) as parent baseline when a competition elects standard quarter structure. Confirm local competition timing before air.
